description: Sliding-window identity plot and functional-residue mapping for F6S899 vs human SIRT5
code:
horse=("MRPLQIVHSRLISRLCCGLKSAASTQTKICLTMARPSSNMADFRKFFAKAKHIVVISGAGISAESGVPTFRGAGGYWRKWKAQDLATPQAFARNPSQVWEFYHYRREVVQTKEPNPGHLAIAQCEARLHKQGRRVVVITQNIDELHRKAGTKNLLEIHGSLFKTRCTSCGVVAENYKSPICPALSGKGSPDPETQSARIPAENLPRWEHPLWSILPPCLPPRCLPGEFQWPNSTWKPPQPQADSGFISRGPVVRLFLKPLLTKPKLFLNCPGEGRNYSASVY")
human=("")

import numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def nw(a,b,match=2,mis=-1,gap=-2):
    n,m=len(a),len(b);S=np.zeros((n+1,m+1))
    for i in range(n+1):S[i][0]=i*gap
    for j in range(m+1):S[0][j]=j*gap
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=S[i-1][j-1]+(match if ai==b[j-1] else mis)
            S[i][j]=max(d,S[i-1][j]+gap,S[i][j-1]+gap)
    i,j=n,m;A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if S[i][j]==S[i-1][j-1]+(match if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else mis):A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif S[i][j]==S[i-1][j]+gap:A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
        else:A.append('-');B.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    while i>0:A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0:A.append('-');B.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(B))
ha,hu=nw(horse,human)

# map human residue index per column
hidx=[]; c=0
for ch in hu:
    if ch!='-': c+=1
    hidx.append(c)
# sliding window identity vs human coordinate
W=15
xs=[];ys=[]
for col in range(len(ha)):
    lo=max(0,col-W);hi=min(len(ha),col+W)
    idn=sum(1 for x,y in zip(ha[lo:hi],hu[lo:hi]) if x==y and x!='-')
    tot=sum(1 for y in hu[lo:hi] if y!='-')
    xs.append(hidx[col]); ys.append(100*idn/max(tot,1))

# Key functional residues (human numbering) & horse status
key={102:"Tyr102 (succinyl pocket)",105:"Arg105 (succinyl carboxylate)",
     158:"His158 (catalytic)",166:"Cys166 (Zn)",169:"Cys169 (Zn)",
     241:"Cys241 (Zn, CDLC)",244:"Cys244 (Zn, CDLC)",
     253:"Ser251/Gly-rich NAD loop (GTSSVVYP)",280:"Asn/NTETTP NAD loop"}
# determine horse residue aligned to each human position
def horse_at(hpos):
    for col in range(len(ha)):
        if hidx[col]==hpos and hu[col]!='-':
            return ha[col]
    return '?'
print("Human->Horse residue at key positions:")
for p,name in sorted(key.items()):
    print(f"  H{p} {human[p-1] if p<=len(human) else '?'} -> horse '{horse_at(p)}'  [{name}]")

# where does conservation collapse?
diverg=next(x for x,y in zip(xs,ys) if x>150 and y<50)
print("\nConservation collapses at ~human residue:",diverg)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,4))
plt.plot(xs,ys,lw=1.5)
plt.axhline(50,ls='--',c='gray')
plt.fill_between(xs,ys,where=[v<50 for v in ys],color='red',alpha=0.2)
for p in [102,105,158,166,169,241,244]:
    plt.axvline(p,color='green' if p<188 else 'red',ls=':',alpha=0.6)
plt.xlabel("Human SIRT5 residue position"); plt.ylabel(f"% identity ({2*W}-aa window)")
plt.title("F6S899 (horse) vs human SIRT5: identity collapses after ~res 188 (catalytic C-term lost)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("sirt5_identity.png",dpi=120)
print("saved plot")
